articles.title: New quantum model slashes hardware needed to break bitcoin keys by 17 times
articles.snippet: Alice & Bob's new model reduces the hardware required for a potential attack, bringing it closer to reality and increasing pressure to adopt quantum-resistant security sooner.

articles.title: Polygon expands Open Money Stack to Solana, after Tron rollout
articles.snippet: The move follows the addition of Tron support and Polygon’s acquisition of Coinme.

articles.title: Polymarket Pauses Trading as Prediction Market Investigates Security Incident
articles.snippet: Polymarket restricted trading and paused relayer actions as users report funds leaving their accounts. A suspected attacker wallet holds about $2.65 million in POL, per Arkham data.
